description: Divides the tempo of an incoming clock

params.text: Sets the division in whole steps from = , which passes the clock through, down to /16

inputs.text: Adds to the DIVIDE knob, 5V covering the whole range, and the total is held inside the knob's own limits
The clock whose tempo is divided

outputs.text: An 8V gate at the divided rate, high for half of each period

notes: The output stays at 0V until a clock arrives at CLK IN.

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1: high above 1.5V · stepped · one channel only
